list.name: family
list.label: Formula family
list.query: Future : future, Option : option, Fixed income : fixed_income, Forward : forward, Swap : swap, OTC option : otc_option, Repo : repo, Spot : spot, No risk : no_risk

list.name: formula
list.label: Formula
list.query:
SELECT lpad(formula_id::VARCHAR, 3, '0') || ' ' || arg_max(formula_name, trad_dt) AS formula
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY formula_id
ORDER BY formula_id
list.definition:
SELECT lpad(formula_id::VARCHAR, 3, '0') || ' ' || arg_max(formula_name, trad_dt) AS formula
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY formula_id
ORDER BY formula_id

panels.title: Formulas published (latest day)
panels.description: How many of the selected formulas are in the latest file in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT formula_id) AS formulas
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Publication days
panels.description: Days in the range with at least one selected formula published.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS days
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
  AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: Share of file days in the range on which each selected formula was present, averaged over the formulas.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
days AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) / nullif(count(DISTINCT formula_id) * (SELECT n FROM days), 0) AS coverage
FROM d

panels.title: Changes in range
panels.description: Selected formulas added, removed or renamed vs the previous file, summed over the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id, formula_name, formula_family
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM raw)
),
d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM raw
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
),
cur AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM d
  JOIN days USING (trad_dt)
  WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
),
prv AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, d.formula_id, d.formula_name
  FROM days
  JOIN d ON d.trad_dt = days.prev_dt
)
SELECT count(*) AS changes
FROM cur c
FULL JOIN prv p
  ON c.trad_dt = p.trad_dt
  AND c.formula_id = p.formula_id
WHERE (p.formula_id IS NULL OR c.formula_id IS NULL OR c.formula_name <> p.formula_name)
  AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(c.trad_dt, p.trad_dt)::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Formula presence
panels.description: 1 when the selected formula is in that day's file, 0 when it is missing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
sel AS (
  SELECT formula_id, lpad(formula_id::VARCHAR, 3, '0') || ' ' || arg_max(formula_name, trad_dt) AS formula
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
  GROUP BY formula_id
),
f AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, sel.formula, (f.formula_id IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS published
FROM days
CROSS JOIN sel
LEFT JOIN f ON f.trad_dt = days.trad_dt AND f.formula_id = sel.formula_id
ORDER BY time, formula

panels.title: Consecutive days published
panels.description: Unbroken run of daily files containing each selected formula, counted from the start of the stored history.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS day_no
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM f)
),
sel AS (
  SELECT formula_id, lpad(formula_id::VARCHAR, 3, '0') || ' ' || arg_max(formula_name, trad_dt) AS formula
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
  GROUP BY formula_id
),
islands AS (
  SELECT f.trad_dt, sel.formula, days.day_no - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.formula_id ORDER BY f.trad_dt) AS island
  FROM f
  JOIN sel USING (formula_id)
  JOIN days USING (trad_dt)
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY formula, island ORDER BY trad_dt) AS streak
  FROM islands
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, formula, streak
FROM streaks
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, formula

panels.title: Day-over-day presence change
panels.description: +1 when a selected formula reappears and -1 when it drops out, vs the previous daily file.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM f
),
sel AS (
  SELECT formula_id, lpad(formula_id::VARCHAR, 3, '0') || ' ' || arg_max(formula_name, trad_dt) AS formula
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
  GROUP BY formula_id
),
grid AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, sel.formula, (f.formula_id IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS published
  FROM days
  CROSS JOIN sel
  LEFT JOIN f ON f.trad_dt = days.trad_dt AND f.formula_id = sel.formula_id
),
changes AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula, published - lag(published) OVER (PARTITION BY formula ORDER BY trad_dt) AS change
  FROM grid
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, formula, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, formula

panels.title: Formulas per family, stacked
panels.description: Daily formula count per selected family, stacked so the top edge is the total; ignores the formula filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, formula_family, count(*)::BIGINT AS formulas
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, formula_family

panels.title: Net change in formulas per family
panels.description: Formula count per selected family vs the previous daily file; ignores the formula filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_family
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM raw
),
fams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT formula_family FROM raw WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
),
counts AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_family, count(*) AS n
  FROM raw
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
grid AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, fams.formula_family, coalesce(counts.n, 0) AS n
  FROM days
  CROSS JOIN fams
  LEFT JOIN counts ON counts.trad_dt = days.trad_dt AND counts.formula_family = fams.formula_family
),
changes AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_family, n - lag(n) OVER (PARTITION BY formula_family ORDER BY trad_dt) AS change
  FROM grid
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, formula_family, change::BIGINT AS change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, formula_family

panels.title: Selected formulas (latest day in range)
panels.description: Latest name, first and last appearance, days published and name variants for the selected formulas.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND formula_id IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(split_part(f, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT) FROM unnest([$formula]) AS u(f))
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
days AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS n, max(trad_dt) AS latest
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
hist AS (
  SELECT formula_id, min(trad_dt) AS first_seen
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  GROUP BY formula_id
)
SELECT
  d.formula_id,
  arg_max(d.formula_family, d.trad_dt) AS formula_family,
  arg_max(d.formula_name, d.trad_dt) AS formula_name,
  any_value(hist.first_seen) AS first_seen,
  max(d.trad_dt) AS last_seen,
  max(d.trad_dt) = any_value(days.latest) AS on_latest_day,
  count(DISTINCT d.trad_dt) AS days_published,
  count(DISTINCT d.trad_dt) / any_value(days.n) AS coverage,
  count(DISTINCT d.formula_name) AS names_in_range
FROM d
JOIN hist USING (formula_id)
CROSS JOIN days
GROUP BY d.formula_id
ORDER BY d.formula_id

panels.title: Least consistently published (range)
panels.description: 15 formulas with the most missing days or name variants in the selected families; ignores the formula filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
days AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  formula_id,
  arg_max(formula_family, trad_dt) AS formula_family,
  arg_max(formula_name, trad_dt) AS formula_name,
  count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS days_published,
  any_value(days.n) - count(DISTINCT trad_dt) AS missing_days,
  count(DISTINCT trad_dt) / any_value(days.n) AS coverage,
  count(DISTINCT formula_name) AS names_in_range
FROM d
CROSS JOIN days
GROUP BY formula_id
ORDER BY coverage ASC, names_in_range DESC, formula_id
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Formulas per family (latest day, all families)
panels.description: Formula count per family in the latest file in the range; ignores both filters.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT formula_family, count(*)::BIGINT AS formulas
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY formulas DESC, min(formula_id)

panels.title: Formula changes vs previous file (added / removed / renamed)
panels.description: Formulas in the selected families added, removed or renamed vs the previous daily file; ignores the formula filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_id, formula_name, formula_family
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM raw)
),
d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM raw
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM d
  JOIN days USING (trad_dt)
  WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
),
prv AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, d.formula_id, d.formula_name, d.formula_family
  FROM days
  JOIN d ON d.trad_dt = days.prev_dt
)
SELECT coalesce(c.trad_dt, p.trad_dt) AS trad_dt,
  CASE
    WHEN p.formula_id IS NULL THEN 'added'
    WHEN c.formula_id IS NULL THEN 'removed'
    ELSE 'renamed'
  END AS change,
  coalesce(c.formula_id, p.formula_id) AS formula_id,
  coalesce(c.formula_family, p.formula_family) AS formula_family,
  p.formula_name AS prev_formula_name,
  c.formula_name AS formula_name
FROM cur c
FULL JOIN prv p
  ON c.trad_dt = p.trad_dt
  AND c.formula_id = p.formula_id
WHERE (p.formula_id IS NULL OR c.formula_id IS NULL OR c.formula_name <> p.formula_name)
  AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(c.trad_dt, p.trad_dt)::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY trad_dt DESC, formula_id
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Risk formula catalog (latest day in range)
panels.description: All formulas of the selected families in the latest file; ignores the formula filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_family IN ($family)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
hist AS (
  SELECT formula_id, min(trad_dt) AS first_seen
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  GROUP BY formula_id
)
SELECT d.formula_id,
  d.formula_family,
  d.formula_name,
  hist.first_seen
FROM d
JOIN hist USING (formula_id)
WHERE d.trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY d.formula_id

panels.title: $formula
panels.description: Published name per day, with days missing from the file marked as not published, one panel per selected formula.

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
f AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, formula_name
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE formula_id = TRY_CAST(split_part($formula, ' ', 1) AS BIGINT)
    AND formula_family IN ($family)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, coalesce(f.formula_name, '(not published)') AS name
FROM days
LEFT JOIN f USING (trad_dt)
ORDER BY time
